## Unit step response of 1st order system

<div style="text-align: center">

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=latex, thick]
  \node[draw, minimum width=2.2cm, minimum height=1cm] (sys) {$\displaystyle\frac{a}{s+a}$};

  \draw[->] (-3,0) -- (sys.west);
  \draw[->] (sys.east) -- (3,0);

  \node[above] at (-3,0) {$X(s)$};
  \node[below,red] at (-3,0) {$\displaystyle\frac{1}{s}$};
  \node[above] at (3,0) {$Y(s)$};

\end{tikzpicture}
```

</div>

::: {layout-ncol=2}

\begin{align*}
    Y(s) &= \frac{1}{s} \cdot \frac{a}{s+a} \\
    &= \frac{1}{s} - \frac{1}{s+a}
\end{align*}

&nbsp;

<span style="color:blue;">Inverse L.T.:</span>
$$ \color{blue} y(t) = 1 - e^{-at} $$

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black}
]
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (4.3,0) node[right] {$t$};
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$y(t)$};

    \draw[domain=0:4, samples=100, smooth, thick, blue] plot (\x, {1 - exp(-1*\x)});

    \draw[dashed] (1,0) -- (1,0.6321);
    \draw[dashed] (0,0.6321) -- (1,0.6321);
    \draw[dashed] (0,1) -- (4,1);
    \draw[dashed] (4,0) -- (4,0.98);

    \node[below] at (1,0) {$\tau = \frac{1}{a}$};
    \node[left] at (0,0.6321) {$0.63$};
    \node[below, red] at (4,0) {$4 \tau$};
    \node[left, blue] at (0,1) {$1$};
    \node[right, red] at (4,0.98) {$0.98$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```

:::

&nbsp;<br>
$\boxed{\textbf{Performance Index}}$

<ul style="list-style-type: '① ';">
<li>Time constant $\tau = \displaystyle\frac{1}{a}$<br>
$y(t=\tau) = 1 - e^{-1} \approx 0.63(2121)$</li>
</ul>

<ul style="list-style-type: '② ';">
<li>Settling time:<br>
$T_{ss} = 4 \tau = \displaystyle\frac{4}{a}\quad$ <span style="color:red;">(2%)</span><br>
$y(t=4\tau) = 1 - e^{-4} \approx 0.98(1684)$<br>
$\color{green} T_{ss} = 3 \tau$ <span style="color:green;">(5%)</span><br>
$\color{green}y(t=3\tau) = 1 - e^{-3} \approx 0.95(0213)$
</li>
</ul>

::: {layout="[0.3, 0.7]"}

$\color{RedOrange}\underline{\text{Unit impulse response}}$<br>

&nbsp;

$\color{RedOrange}\mathcal{L}\{\delta(t)\} = 1$<br>
$\color{RedOrange}Y(s) = \displaystyle\frac{a}{s+a}$<br>
$\color{RedOrange}y(t) = a \cdot e^{-at}$

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, orange!80!black}
]
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (2,0) node[right] {$t$};
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$y(t)$};
    \draw[domain=0:2, samples=100, smooth, thick, axis] plot (\x, {exp(-1*\x)});
    \node[left,orange!80!black] at (0,1) {$a$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```

:::


## Unit impulse response of 2nd order system

$$\color{red}\boxed{\color{black}\frac{\omega_n^2}{s^2+2 \xi \omega_n s + \omega_n^2}} \quad \color{red}\text{typical}$$

::: {layout-ncol=2}

$$ \frac{\omega_n^2}{s^2 + 2 \xi \omega_n s} = \frac{\omega_n^2}{s(s + 2 \xi \omega_n)} = \color{red}\underset{\text{1st}}{\underline{\color{black}\frac{a_1}{s}}} \color{black} - \color{red}\underset{\text{1st}}{\underline{\color{black}\frac{a_2}{s+2\xi\omega_n}}}$$

&nbsp;

$$ \frac{\omega_n^2}{s^2 + \omega_n^2} = \frac{\omega_n^2}{(s + j\omega_n)(s - j\omega_n)} $$

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black}
]
    \begin{scope}
    \draw[->, axis] (-1.5,0) -- (1.5,0) node[right] {$\sigma$};
    \draw[->, axis] (0,-1.5) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$j\omega$};

    \node[red, right] at (0,1) {$j\omega_n$};
    \node[red, right] at (0,-1) {$-j\omega_n$};
    \fill[red] (0,1) circle (0.1);
    \fill[red] (0,-1) circle (0.1);
    \end{scope}

    \begin{scope}[xshift=2.2cm]
    \draw[domain=0:2, samples=100, smooth, thick, red] plot (\x, {0.5*sin(deg(4*pi*\x))});
    \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
```

:::

<span style="color:red;">For typical 2nd order systems:</span>
$$\color{red}\text{C.E.} \quad \color{blue}\underset{a}{\underline{1}}\color{red}s^2 + \color{blue}\underset{b}{\underline{\color{red}2 \xi \omega_n}} \color{red} s + \color{blue}\underset{c}{\underline{\color{red}\omega_n^2}} \color{red} = 0$$

\begin{align*}
    s &= \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a} \\
      &= \frac{-2 \xi \omega_n \pm \sqrt{(2 \xi \omega_n)^2 - 4 \omega_n^2}}{2} \\
      &= \frac{-2 \xi \omega_n \pm 2 \omega_n \sqrt{\xi^2 - 1}}{2} \\
      &= -\xi \omega_n \pm \omega_n \sqrt{\xi^2 - 1}
\end{align*}

::: {layout="[0.75, 0.25]"}

When $\xi > 1$, overdamped.
$$\color{YellowOrange}\text{S.O.S.} = \frac{a_1}{s+p_1} + \frac{a_2}{s+p_2} \color{blue} = \boxed{a_1 \cdot e^{p_1 t} + a_2 \cdot e^{p_2 t}}$$

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black}
]
    \draw[->, axis] (-1.5,0) -- (1.5,0) node[right] {$\sigma$};
    \draw[->, axis] (0,-1.5) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$j\omega$};
    \node[red, below] at (-1,0) {$p_1$};
    \node[red, below] at (-0.5,0) {$p_2$};
    \fill[red] (-1,0) circle (0.05);
    \fill[red] (-0.5,0) circle (0.05);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

:::

::: {layout="[0.75, 0.25]"}

When $\xi = 1$, critically damped.
$$\color{YellowOrange}\text{S.O.S.} = \frac{\omega_n^2}{(s+\omega_n)^2} = \color{blue} \boxed{(a_1 + a_2 t) \cdot e^{-\omega_n t}}$$

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black}
]
    \draw[->, axis] (-1.5,0) -- (1.5,0) node[right] {$\sigma$};
    \draw[->, axis] (0,-1.5) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$j\omega$};
    \node[red, below] at (-0.8,0) {$-\xi \omega_n$};
    \fill[red] (-0.8,0) circle (0.05);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

:::

::: {layout="[0.75, 0.25]"}

$\color{red}\boxed{\color{black}\text{When }\xi < 1\text{, underdamped.}}$
\begin{align*}
\color{YellowOrange}s &\color{YellowOrange}= -\color{red}\underset{\sigma}{\underbrace{\color{YellowOrange}\xi \omega_n}} \pm j \cdot \color{red}\underset{\omega}{\underbrace{\color{YellowOrange}\sqrt{1 - \xi^2} \cdot \omega_n}} \\[1ex]
\color{red} s &\color{red}= -\sigma \pm j \omega
\end{align*}

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black}
]
    \draw[->, axis] (-1.5,0) -- (1.5,0) node[right] {$\sigma$};
    \draw[->, axis] (0,-1.5) -- (0,1.5) node[above] {$j\omega$};
    \fill[red] (-0.8,0.7) circle (0.05);
    \node[red, below] at (-0.8,0) {$-\xi \omega_n$};
    \node[red, right] at (0,0.7) {$\sqrt{1-\xi^2} \cdot \omega_n$};
    \draw[red, dashed] (-0.8,0) -- (-0.8,0.7);
    \draw[red, dashed] (-0.8,0.7) -- (0,0.7);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

:::

\begin{align*}
    \frac{\omega_n^2}{s^2 + 2 \xi \omega_n s + \omega_n^2} &= \frac{\omega_n^2}{(s + \xi \omega_n)^2 + (1-\xi^2) \omega_n^2} \\
    &= \frac{\omega_n^2}{(s + \sigma)^2 + \omega^2} \\
    &= \frac{c_1}{(s + \sigma) + j \omega} + \frac{c_2}{(s + \sigma) - j \omega}
\end{align*}

<div style="color:green;">
To find $c_1$ and $c_2$:
\begin{align*}
    c_1 \cdot (s+\sigma - j \omega) + c_2 \cdot (s+\sigma + j \omega) &= \omega_n^2 \\
    \color{red}\underset{0}{\underbrace{\color{green}(c_1 + c_2)}} \cdot (s+\sigma) + j \omega (c_2 - c_1) &= \omega_n^2
\end{align*}
</div>

$$ \color{Orchid}c_1 = -c_2 $$
$$ \color{Orchid}2c_2 \cdot j \omega = \omega_n^2 \implies c_2 = \frac{\omega_n^2}{2 j \omega},\quad c_1 = -\frac{\omega_n^2}{2 j \omega}$$

\usepackage{cancel}
\begin{align*}
    \mathcal{L}^{-1}\left\{\frac{\omega_n^2}{(s + \sigma)^2 + \omega^2}\right\} &= c_1\cdot e^{-(\sigma + j \omega)t} + c_2\cdot e^{-(\sigma - j \omega)t} \\
    &= -\frac{\omega_n^2}{2 j \omega} \cdot e^{-\sigma t} \cdot e^{-j \omega t} + \frac{\omega_n^2}{2 j \omega} \cdot e^{-\sigma t} \cdot e^{j \omega t} \\
    &= \frac{\omega_n^2}{\color{YellowOrange}\cancel{\color{black}2j}\color{black}\omega} \color{black}\cdot e^{-\sigma t} \cdot \color{YellowOrange}\frac{\color{black}(e^{j \omega t} - e^{-j \omega t})}{2j} \\
    &= \frac{\omega_n^2}{\omega} \cdot e^{-\sigma t} \cdot \sin(\omega t) \\
    &= \color{red}\underline{\underline{\color{black}\frac{\omega_n}{\sqrt{1-\xi^2}} \cdot e^{-\xi \omega_n t} \cdot \sin(\sqrt{1-\xi^2} \cdot \omega_n t)}} \quad \text{unit impulse response}
\end{align*}

## Unit step response of S.O.S.

\begin{array}{lll}
\text{Overdamped } & \xi > 1 & \displaystyle\frac{a_1}{s+p_1} + \frac{a_2}{s+p_2} \\
& & \boxed{a_1 \cdot e^{p_1 t} + a_2 \cdot e^{p_2 t}} \\
\text{Critically damped } & \xi = 1 & \displaystyle\frac{\omega_n^2}{(s+\omega_n)^2} \\
& & \boxed{(a_1 + a_2 t) \cdot e^{-\omega_n t}} \\
\text{Underdamped } & \xi < 1 & \displaystyle\frac{c_1}{s + \sigma + j \omega} + \frac{c_2}{s + \sigma - j \omega} \\
& & \boxed{\frac{\omega_n}{\sqrt{1-\xi^2}} \cdot e^{-\xi \omega_n t} \cdot \sin(\sqrt{1-\xi^2} \cdot \omega_n t)}
\end{array}

<div style="text-align: center">

```{.tikz}

  \node[draw, minimum width=2.2cm, minimum height=1cm] (sys) {$\displaystyle\frac{\omega_n^2}{s^2 + 2 \xi \omega_n s + \omega_n^2}$};

  \draw[->] (-3,0) -- (sys.west);
  \draw[->] (sys.east) -- (3,0);

  \node[above,red] at (-3,0) {$\displaystyle\frac{1}{s}$};
  \node[above,red] at (3,0) {$Y(s)$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```

</div>

\begin{align*}
    Y(s) &= \frac{1}{s} \cdot \frac{\omega_n^2}{s^2 + 2 \xi \omega_n s + \omega_n^2} \\
    &= \frac{c_1}{s} + \frac{c_2}{s + \sigma + j\omega} + \frac{c_3}{s + \sigma - j\omega}
\end{align*}
